sidecar.tests: cargo test -- --skip cdp_ -> 40 passed / 0 failed / 3 filtered, exit 0

stated_gaps: long RPC in-flight Stop preemption not closed

evidence: Sidecar has a typed held ledger and get_health exposes held/maybe-held state.
No sidecar-level ACK-drop injection exists; the lost receipt is a Host/MXU event.
rows.blocker: MXU Host ACK-loss harness: prove no blind replay and preserve the unknown ledger.

evidence: A failed release is retried and can clear the fault, but no lost-ACK scenario is injected.
Host-side no-replay contract is not exercised by the sidecar tests.
rows.blocker: MXU Host ACK-loss harness for the up/release receipt.

evidence: Oversized length, malformed JSON and zero-length control frames are rejected with protocol_mismatch/invalid_params and the pipe is closed.
Rejection happens in parse_client_message before Sidecar::handle, so no command dispatch occurs.
An expired seq is rejected with CommandExpired and the actuator records only one key_down.
Same-seq/different-content SeqConflict exists in code but has no test.
rows.blocker: Add a SeqConflict regression test; current evidence covers expiry/replay only.

evidence: A command with an old generation is rejected with GenerationStale before dispatch.
A post-fence command is also rejected with GenerationStale.
Only deadline_ms == 0 is rejected; a non-zero deadline is never enforced while a command is in flight.
No test covers an actuator that overruns its deadline and later applies the input.
rows.blocker: Implement and test an in-flight deadline/unknown-result path; do not auto-replay.

evidence: A 2 s hold survives the 350 ms lease with renewals; media health gating does not block release inputs.
The control loop waits for the in-flight command before reading Stop/ReleaseAll, so a slow screencap still delays preemption.
rows.blocker: CW2 gap: urgent control path or lock-free actuator preemption.

evidence: Limits.max_pending = 64 is defined but has no use site in the sidecar; there is no queue or Backpressure response.
Commands are processed serially; no overload rejection is observed or tested.
rows.blocker: Implement bounded pending/backpressure and a test that exceeds it.

evidence: The control loop reads one command, runs it to completion in spawn_blocking, writes the receipt, then reads the next command.
Stop/Close shares this serial path; there is no fence-first queue drain.
rows.blocker: CW2 gap: fence-first Stop with bounded in-flight command handling.

evidence: With no command, the supervisor tick fences the expired owner, increments the generation, releases the held key and clears the owner.
RenewLease keeps a 2 s hold alive across the 350 ms lease.
Lease expiry fences and releases; no dedicated renew-channel loss/delay test exists.
rows.blocker: Add a renew-loss test that proves Faulted before unsafe continuation.

evidence: A second owner is rejected with OwnerConflict; the first owner can still dispatch.
A stale generation is rejected without a second write.
Dropping the control client releases held inputs and fences the generation; the next hello sees generation 2 and empty held state.
A wrong token is rejected; the correct token then establishes the session.
Reconnect after disconnect increments the generation and clears held state.
Snapshot-token/document identity invalidation belongs to CW4 and is not present in this candidate.
rows.blocker: CW4 observation-token work for the token half; generation half is verified.

non_claims: Batch A uses the sidecar fake actuator and local transport; it does not prove real browser or cloud behavior.
A pass means the sidecar protocol behavior is supported by a named test in this candidate, not that CW9-2 or G4 is closed.
The current candidate is CW2-partial: long RPC preemption, owned launcher and Host-death reclamation remain open.
No fault was injected into a real cloud session; no new run was started.
